```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(metR)
library(ggplot2)
library(data.table)
library(lubridate)
library(here)

global_map <- rnaturalearth::ne_coastline()
```

## Data

CMIP6, ScenarioMIP experiments from Tier 1. 

```{r}
data.frame(scenario_name = c("SSP5-8.5", "SSP3-7.0", "SPP2-4.5", "SSP1-2.6"),
           forcing = c("High", "High", "Medium", "Low"),
           forcing_value = c(8.5, 7.0, 4.5, 2.6)) |> 
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Scenario name", "Forcing category", "2100 forcing (Wm-2)"),
               caption = "ScenarioMIP experiment design for Tier 1") |> 
  kableExtra::kable_classic() 
```


```{r}
readr::read_rds(here::here("cmip_file_list.rds")) |> 
  _[nominal_resolution != "500 km", .(source_id, institution_id, nominal_resolution)] |> 
  unique(by = "source_id") |> 
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Model", "Institution", "Original resolution"),
               caption = "List of models used for the analysis.") |> 
  kableExtra::kable_classic()
```

## Results

```{r}
serie <- fread(here("data/cmip/series/serie_freq_year_delta10.csv"))
```


```{r}
serie |>
  _[!(year == 2014 & scenario != "historical")] |>
  _[lat %between% c(-38, -37) & lon == 144] |>
  ggplot(aes(year, mean_freq)) +
  geom_line(aes(color = scenario), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", aes(color = scenario), se = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Frequency (days/year)", color = NULL, 
       title = "Grid point closest to Melbourne") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
serie |> 
  _[, .(mean_freq = mean(mean_freq, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(scenario, lat, lon)] |> 
  ggplot(aes(ConvertLongitude(lon), lat)) +
  geom_contour_fill(aes(z = mean_freq, fill = after_stat(level))) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = 0.5)) +
  geom_sf(data = global_map, inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_sf(ylim = c(-50, 50), expand = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~scenario) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "days/year",
       title = "Change in frequency") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.frame = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
        legend.key.width = grid::unit(1, 'null'))
```



```{r}
serie |> 
  _[lat %between% c(-50, 50)] |> 
  _[, FitLm(mean_freq, year), by = .(scenario, lat, lon)] |> 
  _[term == "year"] |>
  ggplot(aes(ConvertLongitude(lon), lat)) +
  geom_contour_fill(aes(z = estimate, fill = after_stat(level))) +
  scale_fill_divergent_discretised(guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = 0.5)) +
  geom_sf(data = global_map, inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = NA, linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_sf(ylim = c(-50, 50), expand = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~scenario) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "days/year",
       title = "Change in frequency") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        legend.frame = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
        legend.key.width = grid::unit(1, 'null'))
```
